target: Kodi 21.2 Estuary, home with the Movies menu entry (1920x1080)
sources: Lab capture 2026-11-11: Kodi 21.2 (Debian 13 package) in Xvfb at 1920x1080, a ten-title reference library (scripts made the .nfo files; flat-colour posters), ffmpeg x11grab stills and a 30 fps sequence of Down and Right; images kept out of the repo
skin.estuary 21 XML (GPL-2.0): Home.xml, Includes_Home.xml (WidgetGroupListCommon, WidgetListPoster, WidgetListCommon, CategoryLabel), Includes_Animations.xml

measurements.menu: 0..462 wide, full height; entries 95 tall from y 240; label text from x 104, cap centre on the entry centre; focused entry filled #0f85a5 with the 95 px icon cell #0a5b71; menu #0e1315 darkening to #040505 at the ends
measurements.clock: top right, text right edge 1892, cap 35..87 (centre 61)
measurements.categories: title at x 517, cap centre 106; tiles 277x160 at x 551 on a 310 pitch, top 140
measurements.shelves: title x 517, cap centre 356 (second widget) and 839 (third): 483 apart; posters 250x375 at x 565 on a 310 pitch, top 395 (39 below the title's cap centre); no captions
measurements.focus: focused poster zooms to 110% around (50%, 30%) in 200 ms sine in-out with a ~4 px #0f85a5 border fading in over 200 ms; Right from the menu enters the categories row, Down the next shelf
measurements.scroll: group list: shelves move only as far as needed, the focused shelf's bottom no lower than ~920 (Down to the third widget moved everything up 296 px), 500 ms cubic ease-out (frames: 430-470 ms to settle at 15-30 fps); rows: focus walks the four visible slots, the list scrolls a slot at the edge, 500 ms cubic out
measurements.fades: widgets on a section change 300 ms; fanart cross-fade 600 ms; info popup zooms from 80% with a fade, 240 ms back easing after 160 ms
